metadata.question: Is the nighttime light intensity higher in Grindavík compared to Reykjavík on November 21, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) for date 2024-11-21 (or closest before) over two towns in Iceland. Passive fire (FIRMS) and Earth at night layers are unsuitable; we need composite VIIRS DNB. 2. Masking: VIIRS nightly are already cloud-masked at source; we just filter and reduce to mean inside 3 km buffers. 3. Logic: fetch images for that exact date (or the latest available ≤ 2024-11-21). If no nightly tile, try monthly composite. - If no images → C1 - Get pixel count inside buffers; if 0 → C2 - Compute mean radiance for each town; if None/NaN → C3 - Compare Grindavík vs Reykjavík; print tag A if Gridavík’s is strictly larger, else B. 4. Use small scale (1000 m) to keep fast. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & date grindavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-22.446, 63.843]).buffer(3000) reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.942, 64.147]).buffer(3000) date = '2024-11-21' # 2. Data: VIIRS DNB nightly or closest composite col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')\ .filterDate('2024-11-01', '2024-11-30') # monthly closest if col.size().getInfo() == 0: col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')\ .filterDate('2024-10-01', '2024-10-31') size = col.size().getInfo() if size == 0: print("No VIIRS data found.") print("C1") img = ee.Image(col.first()).select('avg_rad') meanG = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=grindavik, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad') meanR = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=reykjavik, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad') valG = ee.Algorithms.If(ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(meanG, None), None, meanG).getInfo() valR = ee.Algorithms.If(ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(meanR, None), None, meanR).getInfo() if valG is None or valR is None: print("C3") countG = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=grindavik, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo() countR = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=reykjavik, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo() if countG == 0 or countR == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") print(f"Grindavík: {valG:.2f} nW cm-2 sr-1; Reykjavík: {valR:.2f} nW cm-2 sr-1") if valG > valR: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & date
grindavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-22.446, 63.843]).buffer(3000)
reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.942, 64.147]).buffer(3000)
date = '2024-11-21'

# 2. Data: VIIRS DNB nightly or closest composite
col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')\
        .filterDate('2024-11-01', '2024-11-30')  # monthly closest
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')\
          .filterDate('2024-10-01', '2024-10-31')
size = col.size().getInfo()
if size == 0:
    print("No VIIRS data found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

img = ee.Image(col.first()).select('avg_rad')
meanG = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=grindavik,
                         scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad')
meanR = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=reykjavik,
                         scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad')
valG = ee.Algorithms.If(ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(meanG, None), None, meanG).getInfo()
valR = ee.Algorithms.If(ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(meanR, None), None, meanR).getInfo()
if valG is None or valR is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
countG = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=grindavik,
                          scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
countR = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=reykjavik,
                          scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
if countG == 0 or countR == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
print(f"Grindavík: {valG:.2f} nW cm-2 sr-1; Reykjavík: {valR:.2f} nW cm-2 sr-1")
if valG > valR:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
